confidence_notes: FX came from one RBA search. It showed 0.6677 USD per AUD for 19 Nov 2026, which looks provisional, and an official 18 Nov rate of 0.6720. I used the 18 Nov figure because it is the published one. Food and drink anchors rest on one search of crowd-sourced cost-of-living sites (MyLifeElsewhere, Traveltables). Their figures vary by snapshot and date. Beer, coffee and the inexpensive meal are fairly well supported. The mid-range meal for two is extrapolated from those. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the beer price and typical Polish ratios, not searched directly. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-sized Polish cities such as Wrocław and Gdańsk, and slightly below Warsaw and Kraków. Poznań has steady business and trade-fair demand.
